metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sermon, the loaf and the sixpence, the letter to Anne, and the pause on the last page.

yesterday: Master Thwaite came to fourteenthly on Lent and turned the glass twice.
The loaf was a penny, and a finger short of the notch. Firing and washing are entered at sixpence. Board was threepence.
You wrote Anne that you will come before Mid-Lent Sunday. The sheet waits for the carrier of the 27th.
You struck the London story. On the comedy you marked a pause and left the ladies' refusal.
